0022600160.text: The Indiana Pacers (2-5, on a four-game losing streak and 12th in the East) host the Atlanta Hawks (3-4, 7th in the East, with a one-game losing streak) in this game, the Pacers' eighth of the season, with both teams having played seven games so far. Indiana is without Ben Sheppard, Ivica Zubac, Johnny Furphy, T.J. McConnell and Tyrese Haliburton, and Obi Toppin is day-to-day with a back issue and listed as a game-time decision, while Atlanta is missing Henri Veesaar, Jock Landale and Mouhamed Gueye, Kingston Flemings is serving a suspension, and Jalen Johnson is day-to-day with an ankle issue and also a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet this season, after the Pacers lost 1-2 in the 2025-26 season series, and their most recent meeting was a 129-124 Indiana win in Indianapolis on January 31.
